title: Zesty Kenyan Meat Kebabs
description: Tangy and pillowy kebabs featuring a blend of Kenyan spices, shortening, and a flavorful marinade, this dish is perfect for adventurous eaters, and is egg-free friendly.

ingredients.name: beef cubes
ingredients.notes: or substitute with lamb or chicken

instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together shortening, lemon juice, ginger paste, garlic paste, Kenyan spice blend, salt, and black pepper to make the marinade.
Add the beef cubes to the marinade and mix well to coat, then cover and refrigerate for at least 2 hours or overnight.
Preheat a grill or grill pan to medium-high heat, about 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Thread the marinated beef cubes, onion, and bell pepper onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Brush the grill or grill pan with oil to prevent sticking, then add the kebabs and cook for 8-10 minutes per side, or until the meat is cooked through.
Serve the kebabs hot, garnished with fresh cilantro or parsley if desired.
Let the kebabs rest for 5 minutes before serving to allow the juices to redistribute.
Serve with your choice of sides, such as rice, naan bread, or roasted vegetables.
